concept: Full-body concept art of a classic western dragon for a fantasy video game, seen strictly from the front: it faces the camera straight on, in a symmetrical standing pose. It has a heavy reptilian body covered in dark red scales with a pale ridged belly, a horned head on a long neck, and two large leathery bat-like wings. Rig-ready pose: its wings are spread wide open to both sides, clearly separated from its body and from its legs, it stands on its four strong clawed legs, straight and slightly apart, every leg clearly visible and separated from the others, and its long spiked tail lies behind it and curls to one side so that its tip is visible next to its feet. One single creature, centered, the whole body visible from head to feet. Plain uniform light grey studio background, no floor, no ground, no pedestal, no cast shadow, soft even studio lighting.
